This secure mechanism ensures that even if an unauthorized user attempts to access the system, they will be unable to bypass the biometric authentication process.

rows.question: How are the two portfolio bots built and how are they evaluated?

Answer A (RAG) is a standard retrieval-augmented generation bot that searches short passages of the knowledge base using BM25 keyword search and embedding search, merges the two rankings with Reciprocal Rank Fusion, and passes the top five passages to the answer model.

Answer B (STAIR-style) is a structure-aware RAG bot inspired by the STAIR paper. It picks up to three sections from the knowledge base's table of contents, checks the choice against the list of real section IDs, and passes the text of those sections to the same answer model.

The two bots are evaluated on a hand-labelled set of questions, each tagged with the section that should answer it. The evaluation metrics include retrieval scores (first-result recall, top-3 recall, and mean reciprocal rank) and answer scores (citation validity, correct refusals, and latency).
